_comment: DigitalDRM Government Holiday list. Sundays are ALWAYS treated as non-working automatically and do not need to be listed here. Add/remove/edit dates below to control which days the reminder/escalation scheduler treats as non-working -- no application code or restart is required; the file is re-read on every scheduled run. Each entry can be a plain 'YYYY-MM-DD' string, or an object with 'date' and an optional 'name' for documentation purposes (the 'name' is not used by the app, it's just for whoever maintains this file).
